name: Prompt Budget by Scope
hypothesis: Applying tighter prompt shaping for low-scope CLI beads reduces input tokens without harming first-pass success.
change: For beads with ≤2 estimated files, cap prompt budget at 50% of baseline; for 3-4 files, cap at 75%. Uses existing ShapeContextForBudget trim cascade with a lower ceiling.
measurement: Compare median input tokens, first-pass success rate, and cost per bead against baseline over next 30 iterations.
risk: Under-context may increase retries on edge cases where dropped learnings/rules were needed.
